the proposed method for EL gold standard dataset creation achieves high Precision and Recall values, and that the dataset itself can be used for the development and evaluation of EL systems in the Music domain.

the proposed dataset is a valuable tool for the evaluation of EL systems in the Music Domain, that it can be used for training EL systems, and that the annotation process can be easily extended to other datasets in the Music Domain.
